QfWud1ZOsvFIIkgt99MFKA.zh: 巴拿馬疫情更新,今年1-2月累計報告1,232例病例,其中5例為重症病例,4例死亡,目前149例住院治療,當局呼籲民眾加強預防措施。
QfWud1ZOsvFIIkgt99MFKA.en: Panama's dengue update: from January to February this year, 1,232 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 5 were severe and 4 died. Currently 149 patients are hospitalized for treatment. Authorities call on the public to strengthen preventive measures.

C1eICBEvoGI_Ksc0EJ_ZTg.zh: 巴拿馬迄今累計600餘例病例,已於7地區傳播,病例主要分布於東部達連省300餘例,該國亦報告1例母子垂直感染病例,當局持續加強相關監測措施。
C1eICBEvoGI_Ksc0EJ_ZTg.en: Panama has reported a cumulative total of more than 600 cases, which have spread to seven regions. Most cases, more than 300, are in Darién province in the east. The country has also reported one case of mother-to-child (vertical) transmission. Authorities continue to strengthen related surveillance measures.

0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.zh: 美洲地區今年截至7月累計11國報告逾12,700例確診病例,其中,巴西、哥倫比亞、古巴、巴拿馬、秘魯及委內瑞拉均有報告本土病例,以往疫情主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟近2年已傳播至原流行區以外地區。泛美衛生組織(PAHO)針對美洲局部地區屈公病疫情及奧羅普切熱病例持續發生,於8/29呼籲美洲地區加強監測及病媒控制,將奧羅普切熱感染納入疑登革熱感染之鑑別診斷中,並提醒可能出現之神經系統併發症狀。
0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.en: In the Americas, as of July this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported more than 12,700 confirmed cases. Locally acquired cases have been reported in Brazil, Colombia, Cuba, Panama, Peru and Venezuela. Previous outbreaks were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in the past two years the disease has spread beyond its original endemic areas. In view of continued chikungunya outbreaks in parts of the Americas and continued Oropouche cases, PAHO on 29 August called on the region to strengthen surveillance and vector control, to include Oropouche infection in the differential diagnosis of suspected dengue, and to be alert to possible neurological complications.

zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

noS9WQSX0FP9eL3lyycmXg.zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,於7/1-11期間報告3,773例病例,今年迄今累計14,000餘例病例及54例死亡,病例數以南部巴里薩爾專區近6,000例最多,其次為吉大港2,000例;該國去年累計101,130例病例及573例死亡,2023年累計321,179例病例及1,705例死亡。 巴拿馬疫情上升,今年截至第25週(6/15-21)累計6,458例病例,其中55例為重症,10例死亡,病例主要發生於10-59歲族群,主要流行型別為DENV-3及DENV-4,造成重症及死亡數增加。
noS9WQSX0FP9eL3lyycmXg.en: Dengue is rising in Bangladesh. Between 1 and 11 July, 3,773 cases were reported. So far this year, more than 14,000 cumulative cases and 54 deaths have been reported. Most cases are in the southern Barisal division, with nearly 6,000, followed by Chattogram with 2,000. Last year the country reported 101,130 cumulative cases and 573 deaths, and in 2023 it reported 321,179 cases and 1,705 deaths. Dengue is also rising in Panama. As of week 25 this year (15–21 June), 6,458 cumulative cases have been reported, of which 55 were severe and 10 were fatal. Cases are mainly among people aged 10–59. The main serotypes circulating are DENV-3 and DENV-4, which have increased severe cases and deaths.

MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.zh: 中南美洲近年病例數上升,巴拿馬/哥斯大黎加/加拉瓜/宏都拉斯/瓜地馬拉/薩爾瓦多/墨西哥等國均有人類感染病例。另加拿大於今年3月報告1例80歲男性病例,具哥斯大黎加旅遊史,顯示其可能透過國際旅遊傳播,增加國際傳播風險。螺旋蠅為寄生性蠅類,其幼蟲可寄生於人類及動物之傷口或天然腔道,造成「蠅蛆症」,目前無疫苗或特效藥物。
MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.en: Human infections have increased in Central and South America in recent years, with human cases reported in Panama, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Mexico and other countries. In addition, Canada reported a case in an 80-year-old man in March this year who had a travel history to Costa Rica, indicating that the disease may spread through international travel and increase the risk of international transmission. The screwworm fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae can parasitize wounds or natural body cavities of humans and animals, causing myiasis. There is currently no vaccine or specific drug.

IDxj_smpsdPZ8f2SE16f-Q.zh: 巴拿馬疫情更新,報告2例死亡病例,分別為10歲及15歲女性個案,分別來自該國中西部及東部省份,為自2017年以來首次報告死亡病例,該國2024年累計15,109例病例,2023年累計11,659例病例,顯示近年疫情呈上升趨勢。
IDxj_smpsdPZ8f2SE16f-Q.en: Panama update: two deaths were reported, in a 10-year-old female and a 15-year-old female, from the central-western and eastern parts of the country respectively. These are the first deaths reported since 2017. The country reported 15,109 cases cumulatively in 2024 and 11,659 cases in 2023, indicating a rising trend in recent years.

CZONnBxo0MfbhVrZt9EOCQ.zh: 巴拿馬迄今已累計286例病例及1例死亡,病例主要分布於東部達連省264例,年齡分布以25-49歲族群為多,當局已加強相關監測及蚊蟲防治措施。
CZONnBxo0MfbhVrZt9EOCQ.en: Panama has reported 286 cases cumulatively and 1 death, mainly in Darién Province in the east, with 264 cases. The age distribution is mostly among people aged 25–49. Authorities have strengthened related surveillance and mosquito control measures.

2HzbZIWdjekJ9AF7A1VGRw.zh: 巴拿馬疫情更新,今年截至2月累計221例病例及1例死亡,病例主要分布於東部達連省207例,年齡分布以35-49歲為多,當局已加強流行病學監測及相關防治措施。
2HzbZIWdjekJ9AF7A1VGRw.en: Panama update: as of February this year, 221 cases and 1 death have been reported cumulatively, with cases mainly in Darién Province in the east (207), and most cases among people aged 35–49. Authorities have strengthened epidemiological surveillance and related prevention and control measures.

TFuWjYaYiX-MwkfGOm1oMw.zh: 巴拿馬疫情更新,該國東部達連省報告34例病例,分布於梅特蒂(27例)、亞維薩(3例)、里奧伊萊西亞斯(2例)及拉哈斯布蘭卡斯(1例),主要症狀為發燒及頭痛,年齡分布以40-49歲為多,當局建議有症狀的民眾儘速就醫。
TFuWjYaYiX-MwkfGOm1oMw.en: Panama epidemic update: Darién Province in the east of the country has reported 34 cases, distributed among Metetí (27), Yaviza (3), Río Iglesias (2) and Las Blancas (1). The main symptoms are fever and headache, and most cases are in the 40–49 age group. Authorities advise people with symptoms to seek medical care as soon as possible.

WXGJmVZQRL8HdomhxDUcwg.zh: 斯里蘭卡北部省賈夫納市疫情上升,截至12/16累計報告58例病例,其中8例死亡;該國今年迄今累計報告1.2萬例,約200例死亡。 巴拿馬中部科克萊省今年截至12/7累計報告63例病例,其中1例死亡,當局呼籲民眾接觸汙水,應注意防護措施,並注意防鼠及飲水衛生。
WXGJmVZQRL8HdomhxDUcwg.en: Sri Lanka: Cases are rising in Jaffna municipality in the Northern Province; as of 16 December, 58 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 8 deaths. Sri Lanka has reported 12,000 cases this year cumulatively, with about 200 deaths. Panama: In Coclé Province in central Panama, 63 cases had been reported cumulatively as of 7 December this year, including 1 death. Authorities urge people who come into contact with sewage to take protective measures, and to pay attention to rodent control and drinking-water hygiene.

5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至11/25累計11,634例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共11國/地區報告病例,分別為巴西(9,563)、秘魯(936)、古巴(603)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)、蓋亞那(2)及巴拿馬(1)。另美國(94)、加拿大(2)及英屬開曼群島(1)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例;此外,巴西已報告垂直感染確診病例。WHO評估該病毒對區域的公共衛生風險為高,對全球的風險為低。
5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. A total of 11 countries/territories have reported cases: Brazil (9,563), Peru (936), Cuba (603), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2), Guyana (2) and Panama (1). The United States (94), Canada (2) and the British overseas territory of the Cayman Islands (1) have also reported cases, all of them imported. In addition, Brazil has reported confirmed cases of vertical transmission. WHO assesses the public health risk of the virus as high for the region and low for the world.
